name: agent-cache
description: Universal cache for agent task results - 60-80% cost savings

tools.name: cache_get
tools.description: Retrieve cached result for a task. Returns null if not found. Always check cache before executing expensive operations.

key.description: Cache key in format: agent:name:task:type:hash (e.g., agent:research:task:analysis:abc123def)

tools.name: cache_set
tools.description: Store task result in cache for reuse. Call after executing expensive operations with cacheable results.

ttl.description: Time to live in seconds (default 3600 = 1 hour)

tools.name: cache_stats
tools.description: Get cache performance statistics - hit rates, tokens saved, cost savings

tools.name: cache_clear
tools.description: Clear cache entries matching pattern. Use '*' for all. Use with caution - this invalidates cached results.

pattern.description: Glob pattern for keys to clear (default '*' = all)

tools.name: generate_key
tools.description: Helper to generate consistent cache keys for agents

content.description: Task content/query to hash for uniqueness
